project_type: Python http.server backend + vanilla JS frontend, PV installation simulator
build_system: None - pure Python stdlib. No package manager, no build step.
verification_instructions: 1. Run python3 -m unittest discover -s backend/tests -p 'test_*.py' and confirm all tests pass. 2. Verify new TMY integration test passes. 3. Verify fallback to old model works.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - Python stdlib only. Just run tests.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - can access PVGIS API at https://re.jrc.ec.europa.eu/api/v5_3/tmy. Python stdlib only (urllib for HTTP). All code comments must be in Polish.
contribution_requirements: Python stdlib only (no pip packages). Vanilla JS frontend. All comments in Polish. Tests via unittest.
key_patterns: 1. All backend services in backend/services/*.py with Polish function/variable names. 2. API handlers in backend/api/handlers.py return Tuple[int, dict]. 3. Routes registered in backend/main.py PVSimulatorHandler.do_GET/do_POST. 4. Frontend uses localStorage to pass data between pages. 5. Existing PVGIS client in backend/services/pvgis.py uses urllib.request.
directory_structure: backend/ - Python server (main.py, api/handlers.py, services/*.py, tests/test_*.py, data/*.json, models/). frontend/ - HTML/CSS/JS (viewer.html, index.html, pages/, js/, css/). Working directory: /projects/sandbox/Symulator-PV
